Only one face model is enrolled. Glasses: Muenzaniso mumwe chete wechiso wakanyoreswa. Magirazi, kuchinja kwendebvu kana chiedza chakasiyana zvinochinja mataridzire echiso chako kukamera, saka muenzaniso mumwe chete unogona kukundikana (semuenzaniso manheru pasi pemarambi). Wedzera muenzaniso wechipiri nemagirazi kana pasina, chimiro chako chimwe, kana muchiedza chakasiyana kuti kuvhura kurambe kuchivimbika.

How closely your face has to match, and: Kuti chiso chako chinofanira kuenderana zvakadii, uye kana Ubuntu Hello ichifanira kukukumbira kusimbisa kuti uripo chaizvo.
After your face matches, a notification: Kana chiso chako chaenderana, chiziviso chinokukumbira kugutsurira musoro. Mufananidzo wakabatwa pamberi pekamera haugoni kugutsurira musoro.
Enable face authentication to automatica: Gonesa kusimbiswa kwechiso kuti keyring yako yekupinda kana KWallet ivhurwe yega paunopinda. Izvi zvinochengeta password yako zvakachengeteka, yakavharirwa mu TPM kana iripo, kana yakavharidzirwa ne AES-256-GCM uchishandisa kiyi huru ye root chete. Kusimbiswa kwechiso kunoisa PAM_AUTHTOK ye pam_gnome_keyring kana pam_kwallet5 zvichienderana ne desktop yako.
Automatic follows the system language. C: Otomatiki inotevera mutauro wehurongwa. Shanduko dzinoshandiswa pakarepo.

Tapedza! Ubuntu Hello yave kushanda pakombuta iyi. Edza kuita chero chinhu chaungawanzo nyora password yako kuti iite chokwadi, sekumhanyisa rairo ne sudo. Kana iwe wakagonesa keyring auto-unlock, kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet inozovhurwa otomatiki pakupinda.

Because of changes in angles, distance,: Nekuda kweshanduko mumakona, chinhambwe, uye zvimwe zvinhu kuenzaniswa kwechiso hakuna kumbobvira kwakafanana neyakachengetwa modhi yechiso. Pane ino peji unogona kuseta kuti Ubuntu Hello inofanira kuomesesa sei.
The most forgiving match and the quickes: Kuenderana kusina kuoma uye kunokurumidza kukupinza. Sarudza izvi kana kureruka kuchikosha kupfuura kuoma.

The strictest match, with no extra step: Kuenderana kwakanyanya kuoma, pasina danho rekuwedzera paunopinda. Zvinokurudzirwa.
